reason: A web UI plugin that monitors OpenCode Go quota windows through the official usage API and presents live usage, reset countdowns, and refresh status in a floating dock.

summaries.zh: 通过官方用量 API 在浮动网页面板中监控 OpenCode Go 的 5 小时、每周和每月配额使用情况及重置倒计时。
summaries.en: Monitors OpenCode Go five-hour, weekly, and monthly quota usage through the official usage API in a floating web dock with reset countdowns.

capabilities: Reads quota data from an external API using a configured bearer API key
Polls the quota endpoint periodically and displays usage and reset status in a web UI
Provides manual refresh and a link to the external service console
